Current Element	Suggested Change
Header	Add a "Last Updated" timestamp so users know the data is fresh.
Main Center Box	Swap the word "Expenditure Topology" with "Spending chart".
Right Sidebar	Group "Net Worth" and "Credit Card" more tightly; they feel a bit disconnected right now.

**Considering UI Modifications**

I'm currently focused on the user's requested UI changes for the Nova Finance AI application. Adding a "Last Updated" timestamp seems straightforward and I am now considering how best to integrate it without disrupting the existing aesthetic. Also, I'm analyzing the proposed change of the "Expenditure Topology" label to ensure it is clearer and remains consistent with the application's overall purpose.


**Refining App Layout**

I've been working on UI updates, specifically with the app's dashboard. I've begun modifying `Dashboard.tsx` to include a "Last Updated" timestamp near the greeting. I'm also planning to replace the "Expenditure Topology" label with "Spending chart". I am focused on improving the visual grouping of the "Net Worth" and "Credit Card" cards on the sidebar by adjusting the Tailwind grid and gap classes. I intend for the "Last Updated" timestamp to display "Just now" or the current formatted time. The "Spending chart" label styling will remain the same. The timestamp will be small, secondary text.


**Grouping Capital Data**

I'm now refining the visual grouping of the "Net Worth" and "Credit Card" cards on the dashboard. I plan to use a flex or grid container with a smaller gap to present them as "Capital Overview". I will be modifying `Dashboard.tsx`, placing the cards inside this new container. Also, the "Last Updated" logic is simplified, initially showing a static "Just now" or the current formatted time.
